title: Big Take: Can Anthropic Weather a Shifting AI Landscape?
summary: Volatility surged a day after the market debut of Anthropic. Worries over AI, geopolitics and rates are all weighing on investors’ appetite for risk. Ed Ludlow and Bailey Lipschultz join Sarah Holder on the Big Take podcast to explain. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia Employees Complained About Huang’s Behavior Years Ago
summary: About two decades ago, two Nvidia Corp. employees complained about how then-Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang treated his staff, including allegations that he threatened them and made sexually explicit remarks, according to allegations contained in a California lawsuit filed in 2007.

title: Anthropic Founder to Donate to Trump Accounts Following IPO, Bessent Says
summary: Tom Brown, a co-founder and chief compute officer of Anthropic PBC, plans to announce a donation to Trump accounts, according to a person briefed on the matter.

title: Microsoft to Pay Top Cloud Workers More, Crack Down on Others
summary: Microsoft Corp. is making pay more performance-based in its crucial cloud division, the latest tech industry attempt to push employees to work even harder.

title: Anthropic Slips as AI Selloff Spreads
summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Anthropic gives back its debut-day surge, while the selloff spreads from chips to metals and markets around the world. But there are still winners. Anthropic investor and General Catalyst’s Madhu Namburi joins us on what comes next for AI. Plus, Goldman’s David Mericle on why inflation could fall “substantially” by the end of 2027 and Proofpoint CEO Sumit Dhawan joins us on why AI may be making tech outages harder to avoid. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Vows to Tax US Companies Building Data Centers Abroad
summary: President Donald Trump said Friday that he wants to tax companies that build data centers outside the United States. Trump spoke during a press conference at the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Musk Ally Akis Joins Board of DOGE Alumni Firm After New Round
summary: Elon Musk ally Baris Akis is joining the board of Special, a company led by two former staffers from the Department of Government Efficiency, Musk’s controversial government cost-cutting project.

title: YouTube Finalizing Multibillion-Dollar Schools Settlement Over Addiction Claims
summary: Google’s YouTube is finalizing a multibillion-dollar settlement payout to school districts across the US that have accused the company of designing an addictive video platform that has damaged the mental health of students, people familiar with the matter said.

title: Apple Working on Own AI Agent to Rival OpenAI and Anthropic
summary:
Anurag Rana, Senior Tech Analyst for Bloomberg Intelligence, discussed the latest from Apple with Bloomberg's Paul Sweeney.
Apple Inc. is developing its own autonomous artificial intelligence agent that can get things done on behalf of users, looking to enter a fast-growing market already being pursued by OpenAI, Anthropic PBC, Meta Platforms Inc. and others.
The company outlined the plans in job listings added to its website this week. In one, Apple said it’s seeking a senior engineering manager for a proactive, agentic AI assistant. The system will write code, browse the web, control apps and navigate devices on a user’s behalf, according to the post. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: JPMorgan, Visa Warn of Cyberattack That Hit Outside Vendor
summary:
Devon Ackerman, LevelBlue, Global Leader for Digital Forensics and Incident Response, joined Bloomberg's Paul Sweeney and Scarlet Fu  to discuss the recent onslaught of outages and cyber attacks.
JPMorgan Chase & Co., Visa Inc. and Mastercard Inc. said some customer information was accessed in a cyberattack on a vendor.
JPMorgan said it believes, based on an investigation so far, that hackers accessed marketing data held by an outside firm, which may include customer names and email addresses. The bank said the issue isn’t related to an outage it faced earlier this week. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: S&P 500 Heads for Correction as AI Enthusiasm Keeps Unwinding
summary: A slide in the S&P 500 Index on Friday pushed it into a correction territory after a string of disappointing Big Tech earnings and scandal at Nvidia Corp. eroded confidence in the artificial intelligence trade.

title: Europe Retail Traders Bid Seven Times Anthropic’s IPO Allocation
summary: Retail investors in continental Europe submitted orders for about seven times more stock than they were ultimately allocated in Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter, who asked not to be identified as the information is confidential.

title: KKR in Talks to Buy EdgeCore at Valuation of at Least $8 Billion
summary: KKR & Co.’s Helix Digital Infrastructure, the company it launched this year to invest in data centers and other AI-related businesses, is in negotiations to buy a majority stake in EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Emerging Market Stocks on Cusp of Bear Market as AI Rout Expands
summary: Emerging-market stocks extended their declines for a seventh day on Friday, with MSCI’s equity index on the cusp of a bear market amid a continued selloff in global tech shares.

title: AI Speeds Patching, Raises Outage Risks: Expert
summary: A wave of disruptions across banking, travel and government systems may not stem from one sweeping cyberattack says Proofpoint CEO Sumit Dhawan. He joined Bloomberg Open Interest to talk about how AI is helping uncover more vulnerabilities, and forcing companies to patch them faster, increasing the risk of errors. He says the answer is resilience built into systems from the start. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: One Secret to the Success of ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’: Veteran Staff
summary: Nearly 1,000 Rockstar employees have been at the company for a decade or more

title: Anthropic IPO Tests AI Investor Appetite
summary: Renaissance Capital’s Avery Marquez joins Bloomberg Open Interest to weigh Anthropic’s valuation and growth prospects. She also discusses what early trading could signal for future IPOs, including OpenAI’s path to the public markets. ( (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic's IPO Is 'Monstrous,' General Catalyst’s Namburi Says
summary: Madhu Namburi, managing director and co-head of the creation fund at General Catalyst, discusses Anthropic’s "monstrous" IPO after the stock rallied 17% on its first day before moving back toward its $86 listing price. Speaking on "Bloomberg Open Interest," Namburi says Anthropic can withstand the market volatility and the stock has a lot more potential. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic Share Slump Nearly Erases IPO Pop
summary:
Anthropic PBC shares erased much of their first-day jump on Friday, testing investors’ faith after the AI lab delivered the biggest initial public offering in history.
Gene Munster, Managing Partner at Deepwater Asset Management and Ted Mortonson, Managing Director: Technology at Baird, discuss AI trade volatility and how Nvidia and Anthropic have reshaped the AI narrative. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: ING’s $500 Million Data Center Loan Auction Stalls on Low Bids
summary: Dutch bank ING received muted demand for a roughly $500 million auction of data center loans ahead of its deadline, prompting the lender to seek individual sales of the debt instead.
